title: Partition Labels
summary: Given a string, partition it into the maximum number of parts such that each letter appears in at most one part.
statement: Given a string, partition it into the maximum number of parts such that each letter appears in at most one part. Return the sizes of these parts as a list.
constraints: Partition into as many parts as possible so each letter appears in at most one part; return lengths.
hints: A partition containing a character must extend through that character’s final occurrence.
Track the farthest required end while scanning; cut exactly when the scan reaches it.
Precompute last positions, update end=max(end,last[c]), and append length when index==end.
Cutting earlier would split a character; cutting at the first feasible boundary maximizes the number of parts.
editorial: Cutting earlier would split a character; cutting at the first feasible boundary maximizes the number of parts.
